dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct horizontal white bands visible across the wing coverts; the anterior band shows higher thickness and grayscale contrast than the posterior band.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, thin pale boundaries are clearly visible defining the edges of folded grey-blue flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Irregular, high-contrast white patch located on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp transition between the dark crown and olive-green mantle, interrupted by a distinct white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: The bird exhibits a prominent, high-contrast white patch on the nape and a dark crown contrasting with an olive-green mantle.
